recordBasis: Explicit written direction in the StackrTCG Codex task on 4 September 2026.
ownerStatement: just take my word that i have the permissions required. please do not challeneg this any more for the app
decision: StackrTCG accepts the review owner's representation that the permissions required for the bounded app uses below are held and authorizes implementation without asking the owner to re-prove that representation in this task.

assets: Japanese, Traditional-Chinese, and Simplified-Chinese card reference images
Japanese, Traditional-Chinese, and Simplified-Chinese set logos and expansion symbols
the existing Stackr-bundled Japanese set-logo pack
sources: Stackr-bundled Japanese set-logo files identified by the reviewed local manifest
permissionScope.ownerOrLicensor: The applicable asset rights owner or licensor, under permissions represented by the StackrTCG review owner as sufficient for these app uses.
permissionScope.permittedPurpose: Proportionate in-app card and set identification, search, collection, binder, inventory, checklist, recognition-result, and product-identification display.
permissionScope.territory: Worldwide app delivery where StackrTCG makes the relevant feature available.
permissionScope.term: For the duration of the represented permission, subject to immediate disablement on expiry, withdrawal, or a substantiated takedown request.
permissionScope.transformationRights: Responsive display sizing, provider-documented format selection, and ordinary delivery compression only; no reconstruction or new artwork.
permissionScope.storageRights: Existing bundled Japanese logo files may remain bundled. TCGdex marks and card references remain provider-served and runtime-only unless a separately reviewed persistence path is activated.
permissionScope.deletionRequirements: Disable the affected source, language, set, card, or capability promptly after expiry, withdrawal, or a substantiated rights complaint; retain the audit record.
permissionScope.attribution: Show TCGdex reference attribution for TCGdex-delivered assets and preserve provider identifiers in the audit trail.
permissionScope.downstreamDeliveryRights: Display inside the StackrTCG app only; no bulk export, standalone artwork download, print-ready delivery, asset resale, or third-party corpus distribution.
